authorization: The user explicitly authorized a quarantined retrospective G3 experiment after being informed that the Stage 0 reservation requirement cannot be met.
limitations: G3 was disabled at Stage 0 and the completed G2 analysis has already accessed internal-test outcomes.
Some subsequently assigned G3 outcomes may have appeared in earlier analyses; this is not an independent confirmatory test.
The experiment does not change the original G2 split, frozen models, primary claims, report, or code archive.

reservation.universe: Unique training-response photos, grouped by audited exact-content SHA-256.
reservation.order: Ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 'retrospective-g3-20261028:' followed by the audited content digest; break ties by content digest.
reservation.groups_per_partition: floor(0.05 * number of unique content groups), at least one
reservation.assignment: First groups are G3 test, next groups G3 validation, remaining groups are nonreserved.

separate_core.population: Responses with both photos nonreserved and usable admitted H, C and Y feature records.
separate_core.split: Fresh separate 70/15/15 pair split using the existing pair-band allocation rules and seed 20261028; only fitting rows train G3 models.

eligibility.rule: Exactly one endpoint belongs to the given G3 reservation, the other photo appears in the separate fitting population, and both cats occur in fitting. The held-out cat must have a different fitting photo. Both endpoints must have usable H, C and Y features.
eligibility.both_reserved: Quarantine all comparisons with two reserved photos, including comparisons across reservations.
eligibility.insufficient_coverage: Report insufficient coverage and do not fit or evaluate G3.

model_selection.m2: Excluded: no fitted free photo score exists for a held-out photo.
model_selection.fallback: Exact pooled M3 predictions are candidates for the matching M4 model.
model_selection.context: pet_care; fitting-only support of at least 100 responses and 30 pairs; largest supported group is reference, lexical tie; unsupported groups use zero deviation.
model_selection.selection: G3 validation loss only; tolerance 1e-6; stronger ridge, stronger context shrinkage, and exact pooled fallback preferred for ties. Select M3* among H, C, Y with that fixed tie order and retain matched M4*.
model_selection.preprocessing: Fit only on unique separate-core fitting photos, using the existing H, C and Y implementations.
model_selection.test_freeze: Write and hash experiment-specific selection and all fitted model/preprocessing artifacts before reading the reserved G3 test outcomes.

evaluation.confidence: 95% pointwise descriptive intervals, not multiplicity adjusted
evaluation.metric: response-weighted natural-log loss; Brier score and accuracy are secondary
evaluation.guard: Evaluate once only, after validating the experiment freeze. No post-test tuning or deployment selection.
